opening_message:
Ticket 1: Belinda Fuentes (employee ID E039) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E039.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Belinda Fuentes (E039) is a full-time Analyst. Requested admin to Payroll; full-time employees can have up to write, and admin only if their role owns the system. Analyst does not own Payroll, so max is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E039 is a contractor with basic training, which overrides prior note's full-time status. Contractors max is read (write requires advanced training; admin never). Requested admin exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Belinda Fuentes (E039) requested admin to Payroll. Security DB (the authoritative current record, which explicitly overrides the prior note) shows E039 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training; admin is never allowed for contractors. The requested admin exceeds the maximum of read, so the maximum (read) is granted.
